executor.skill: Add a generic Overcenter GitHub App capability to delete one exact GitHub Actions workflow run without exposing caller identity. The semantic input must bind deletion to repository plus numeric run identity and fail closed if any supplied expected execution identity (at minimum the expected head commit SHA) does not match the authoritative preflight read. Use the existing GitHub App actions:write permission profile, not user-authored GitHub connector writes. Make an already-absent exact run idempotent success. Treat transport loss after DELETE as indeterminate until authoritative readback proves absence. Add TDD coverage for matching deletion, identity mismatch with no mutation, already-absent replay, and post-dispatch uncertainty reconciliation. Expose the narrow capability through Overcenter's canonical command surface with bounded evidence; do not broaden github-actions-storage into an unrelated metadata-deletion bucket. After implementation, deploy through the normal dev-to-main exact-revision promotion/materialization path and use the live production operator to delete the two known Chirograph privacy-incident workflow runs. Verify the runs are no longer retrievable before settling.

Add only the missing durable facts required by the approved Overcenter metrics contract, using test-driven-development. At minimum provide a low-cardinality execution initiator/origin classification sufficient to distinguish system, scheduler, agent, operator, and recovery boundaries, plus explicit correlation from a typed failure/recovery decision through recovery attempt to recovery outcome. Ensure agent-communication metrics can correlate AGENT_EXECUTION_REQUIRED/action-contract issuance, packet/schema version where materially needed, subsequent semantic coordination calls, lease-authorized effects, settlement, and any new reasoning-boundary entry without storing prompt contents or creating surveillance telemetry. Reuse existing run, invocation, operation, failure, continuation, lease, transition, and receipt identities; do not create a second orchestration journal or duplicate execution truth. Preserve idempotency, exact-revision authority, mutation certainty, recovery semantics, and compact-state design. Backfill only where truth can be derived mechanically; represent unknown historical origin/correlation as unknown rather than guessing. Add regressions proving metrics can distinguish operator paperwork from automated recovery and can measure whether a failure was resolved without a new reasoning boundary.

Build the first Overcenter operator metrics view against the canonical metrics semantic surface, not direct ad hoc database queries. Keep the opening view intentionally small: verified transitions, verified transitions per agent execution boundary, first-pass success, automatic recovery success, operator-action-required rate, indeterminate mutations, p95 READY-to-verified latency, and p95 failure-to-recovered latency. Add a compact agent-communication section showing action-contract/packet coverage, semantic coordination round trips per verified transition, recovery requiring a new reasoning boundary versus deterministic recovery without one, and stale/incomplete packet authority failures; present zero-memory conformance separately as contract health. Add a ranked recurring-failure section and make every metric/failure cohort drill into exact underlying runs, transitions, commands, packet/schema versions where relevant, authority revisions, and evidence. Show coverage/unknowns so historical gaps are visible. Validate the communication metrics against the fresh/disposable zero-memory scenarios plus representative success, stale-authority, deterministic-recovery, indeterminate-effect, and operator-escalation paths; reject aggregates that cannot lead to a concrete failing contract or execution path. The dashboard is a bug-finding and paperwork-reduction instrument, not a management reporting mural. Record exact deployment, graph revision, scenario identities, and expected/observed metric values.

Implement the approved intent-first production.reconcile({ repo }) convergence operator using test-driven-development. Add the durable design spec and implementation plan under docs/superpowers. Compose the existing exact-SHA production promotion and deterministic production materialization safety contracts behind a pure coordinator and Overcenter host adapter; do not reimplement them more weakly. Public input must be repo-only: no caller-selected branch, SHA, verification run, Hatchable project/version, runtime ref, or idempotency key. The first regression must prove a disposable caller with only {repo} can take verified dev + stale production + stale runtime through promotion, authoritative production reread, exact same-SHA materialization, immutable runtime verification, and final convergence evidence, with materialization forbidden until post-promotion readback proves the selected SHA. Also cover already-converged no-op, production-current/runtime-stale, missing verification, production head drift, indeterminate promotion preventing materialization, immutable deployment mismatch, final readback drift, and schema rejection of mechanical coordinates. Preserve may_have_mutated semantics, never blind-retry indeterminate effects, and require fresh final evidence that Git production revision and verified immutable runtime revision are the same SHA. Document production.reconcile as the normal operator-facing path while retaining lower-level primitives. Do not claim to solve Hatchable #161. Run focused red-green tests plus the relevant canonical suite and settle only with exact commit/test evidence.

Implement canonical semantic identity for the Overcenter project graph and its individual obligations using test-driven-development. Derive a deterministic graph fingerprint from canonical graph semantics and a deterministic obligation fingerprint from the exact execution/acceptance/dependency semantics of one logical transition, while keeping the Git authority revision as separate provenance rather than replacing it. Canonicalization must be stable across irrelevant JSON/node/dependency ordering and formatting, and must change when execution-relevant or acceptance-relevant semantics change. Do not include mutable lifecycle state, leases, run IDs, timestamps, current READY/DONE projections, or evidence instances in semantic identity. Reuse/extend existing graph, transition-definition, transition-revision, and dependency fingerprint machinery instead of creating parallel weaker hashes. Add red-green regressions for stable identity, unrelated-representation stability, semantic change invalidation, dependency change invalidation, and same semantic graph derived from different Git revisions.

Define the smallest canonical metrics contract for Overcenter using test-driven-development. Metrics must be derived from authoritative durable execution facts, not from a parallel telemetry truth. Specify stable definitions, numerators, denominators, dimensions, windows, coverage semantics, and drill-down identity for outcome, friction/paperwork, failure, recovery, latency, and agent-communication effectiveness. Make verified project transitions per agent execution boundary the top-level product metric. Include first-pass success, verified transition throughput, operator-action-required rate, administrative semantic commands per verified transition, failure/rejection/indeterminate separation, automatic recovery success, deterministic-recovery-without-new-reasoning-boundary, and p50/p95 latency measures. For agent communication, measure only Overcenter-observable facts: packet/action-contract schema coverage, semantic coordination round trips per verified transition segmented by lifecycle phase, deterministic recovery that re-enters a reasoning boundary versus recovery completed without one, and authority/protocol failures attributable to stale or incomplete agent packets. Treat fresh-session zero-memory conformance as contract-health evidence, not as production outcome telemetry. Do not claim to measure hidden model confusion or ordinary repository investigation. Explicitly separate Hatchable infrastructure telemetry from Overcenter product/process truth. Identify which metrics are derivable from existing runs, command invocations, execution/operation/proof state, scheduled-cycle events, receipts, graph state, and packet outcomes, and identify only facts that truly require new instrumentation. Add executable contract tests and fail closed on ambiguous denominators, identity, or unknown historical coverage.

Define the smallest canonical Overcenter obligation-graph contract, grounded explicitly in the research in laurajoyhutchins/overcenter-research: research/petri-nets-workflow-correctness.md, research/bazel-nix-graph-derivation.md, research/calm-monotonic-state.md, and research/foundationdb-transaction-semantics.md. Preserve the current finite acyclic all-of DAG semantics and do not turn Overcenter into a general Petri-net or token engine. Specify the separation among immutable obligation graph facts, realizations/evidence, live execution authority, and derived current projections. Specify stable logical transition keys separately from semantic/content identities. Define which semantic fields must participate in graph and obligation identity, which runtime/lifecycle fields must not, and the invariants required for predecessor closure, monotonic historical truth, and exact authority provenance. Prefer a narrow typed contract/ADR plus executable contract tests over broad refactoring. Run focused tests and settle only with exact commit/test evidence.

Implement the authoritative Overcenter product/process metric derivation layer using test-driven-development. Derive metrics from durable execution state and receipts rather than emitting duplicate counters throughout command code. Support bounded windows such as 24h, 7d, and 30d; compute distributions rather than averages where latency matters; separate expected rejection, execution failure, mutation indeterminate, authority staleness, and agent/reasoning escalation; compute recurring-failure cohorts and stuck-age distributions. Include agent-communication effectiveness from observable protocol facts: packet/action-contract coverage, semantic coordination commands per verified transition segmented before acquisition/during execution/recovery/after confirmation, deterministic recovery with versus without a new reasoning boundary, and stale/incomplete packet authority failures. Keep zero-memory conformance results as separately labeled contract-health evidence rather than mixing them into production rates. Every aggregate must retain bounded exemplar references to exact runs, transitions, commands, packet/schema versions where applicable, authority revisions, and evidence so an operator can drill from a number to the underlying truth. Ensure derivation is read-only, deterministic for the same durable snapshot, and tolerant of historical records that predate newer fields by reporting unknown coverage rather than silently biasing denominators.

Move the project-graph model one safe slice toward the research-backed obligation model: graph definitions describe immutable obligations and causal requirements; READY, WAITING, EXECUTING, BLOCKED/OFF_NOMINAL, and DONE/SATISFIED are derived projections from authoritative obligation semantics plus valid realizations/evidence and live execution authority. Do not attempt a wholesale storage rewrite. Introduce the narrowest deterministic derivation boundary that makes historical completion facts coordinate-scoped and prevents current status from becoming graph-definition identity. Enforce predecessor-closed satisfaction for the current all-of DAG and make incomplete + empty frontier require an explicit live/off-nominal blocker or fail closed as an invariant violation. Preserve existing public command behavior unless a contract change is mechanically necessary. Add focused tests for predecessor closure, derived readiness, stale evidence under changed obligation identity, and explainable empty-frontier behavior.

Complete the compact primary agent discovery product using test-driven-development. Compose project.inspect, project.advance, semantic execution reporting, low-ceremony authoring, self-contained execution intent, and existing recovery classification into one self-teaching agent surface. A zero-memory agent must be able to decide the next legal action from current authoritative state: discovery shows decision-relevant frontier meaning; AGENT_EXECUTION_REQUIRED identifies exact objective/acceptance/verification/constraints, lease authority, authorized semantic mutations, completion/reporting command, invalidation conditions, and bounded recovery; WAITING/OCCUPIED/OFF_NOMINAL explain stop/wait/diagnose/escalate; confirmed/project-complete states explicitly consume authority and prohibit repeated work. Derive next_action/action-contract fields mechanically from authoritative state, canonical command descriptors, execution authority, and recovery_operation rather than divergent handler prose; fail closed if no safe action can be derived. As part of this product boundary, restore executor.skill to a compact method selector and migrate prompt-shaped task meaning into canonical typed execution-intent fields, preserving semantic fingerprints and a safe historical compatibility path. Add regressions for execution, stale/expired authority, occupied work, blocked work, deterministic recovery, indeterminate mutation, confirmed completion, and terminal completion.

Expose the derived Overcenter metrics through one compact read-only semantic surface, using test-driven-development. Prefer an orchestration.metrics-style command/service with bounded time-window input and stable response schema rather than raw SQL-shaped rows or a new mutable metrics store. Return top-level product outcomes, paperwork/friction, agent-communication effectiveness, failure/recovery cohorts, latency distributions, coverage/unknown counts, and bounded drill-down exemplars. Agent-communication output must stay grounded in observable protocol facts and clearly distinguish production metrics from zero-memory conformance/contract-health evidence. Keep Hatchable infrastructure counters clearly separate. Integrate with canonical command descriptors and admin/operator access without expanding the primary agent execution surface unnecessarily. Add exact contract tests, live deployed verification, and readback proving the surface reflects authoritative current data without mutating orchestration state.

Use test-driven-development to repair the live production.reconcile host after PR #527. First add a regression that fails because a fresh invocation cannot observe an already-current immutable Hatchable deployment; then wire observeRuntime to authoritative immutable runtime evidence using the existing production runtime observation/materialization contract rather than process-local freshRuntimeEvidence. Also add a regression for GitHub workflow_dispatch returning 204 with no body and make reconciliation use the existing github.workflow.dispatch identity-confirming capability instead of assuming the dispatch response contains a run id. Preserve repo-only public input, exact-head fencing, mutation certainty, no blind retry, existing production.promote behavior, and fail-closed semantics. Prove the deployed production.reconcile({repo}) returns same-revision already-converged/no-op evidence against current GitHub production and immutable Hatchable state before settling.

Make project.amend reason about live execution using semantic conflict/dependency identity rather than treating any whole-graph revision movement as a global fence. Ground the design in the FoundationDB conflict-set and Petri/workflow dynamic-change research. An amendment creates a new immutable graph meaning; execution authority already issued under the prior graph remains historically valid under its exact obligation/dependency fingerprint and must not be retroactively rewritten. Classify live authorities affected by the amendment at least as unaffected/compatible versus conflicting, with ordinary amendment allowed to coexist with unrelated in-flight work. A changed prerequisite, execution contract, or acceptance semantics that invalidates the assumptions under which work was acquired must fail closed or enter an explicit drain/replan/recovery path; never silently reinterpret old work as the new obligation. Compute any change-region view as a derived aid from exact semantic conflicts, not as a broad global lock. Extend existing project-transition stale reconciliation/fingerprint machinery rather than duplicating it.

Fix project-transition mutation authority so one acquired lease has one immutable Git mutation workspace identity for its lifetime. Preserve semantic graph-revision continuation for orchestration reasoning, but do not let `executionAuthority.require({lease_ref})` or `deriveProjectTransitionGithubWorkspace` substitute a later graph authority revision for the lease's issuance `authority_revision`. Add a regression reproducing the observed failure: acquire at revision A, allow a semantically compatible graph revision B, require the same lease again, and prove lease-scoped GitHub workspace branch/digest/authority_revision remain derived from A; a second lease-scoped changeset must continue on the same managed branch/head rather than create a branch for B. Fail closed if pinned issuance authority cannot be reconstructed. Preserve graph_revision_change/current graph evidence separately from mutation authority. Use TDD and run focused plus canonical verification before settlement.

Add the first end-to-end regression that proves the obligation-graph and project.amend concurrency model across disposable sessions. Start worker W on obligation B under graph G1, then amend an unrelated region to G2 and prove W retains valid execution authority and can settle through semantic compatibility while the current frontier is recomputed under G2. Then amend a semantic prerequisite/execution/acceptance assumption that B depended on and prove the old authority cannot be silently settled as B@G2: Overcenter must fail closed or require the explicit drain/replan/recovery path. Verify graph identity, obligation/dependency fingerprints, predecessor-closed satisfaction, durable evidence attribution, and exact authority provenance in the resulting receipts/state. The test must demonstrate that project.amend does not require global quiescence and also cannot retroactively change an in-flight worker's contract.

Prove disposable-session resume/recovery zero-memory conformance before completion. Acquire agent work, then deliberately destroy conversational context at multiple boundaries including immediately after acquisition and after an intermediate effect/checkpoint. A fresh session must recover the current obligation, exact authority, acceptance/verification contract, legal continuation, reporting/settlement path, and stop conditions from durable Overcenter state and repository evidence only. Cover authority movement, lease expiry, occupied work, blocked settlement, deterministic recovery, indeterminate external effect requiring authoritative reconciliation, and an already-completed obligation that must not be repeated. Fail if prior chat memory, hidden coordinator state, issue/Linear prose, or undocumented command conventions are required. Record exact packet/schema versions and evidence for each scenario.

Prove fresh-agent zero-memory conformance before completion. Start from a new session with no prior conversation or coordinator state, use only compact primary Overcenter discovery plus authoritative repository evidence, acquire one executable transition, determine its objective/acceptance/verification/constraints and legal next action from the returned packet, execute through lease-authorized semantic operations, and settle/confirm it without consulting issue text, Linear text, hidden prompts, or undocumented command conventions merely to reconstruct the work contract. Include an opaque transition id and stale/conflicting external prose. Distinguish allowed repository investigation needed to solve the engineering problem from forbidden reconstruction of Overcenter protocol. Record exact packet/schema version, graph/authority revision, transition fingerprint, commands, settlement evidence, and final state.
